nodes.rationale: MeteoSwiss has no fog-top measurement, so the top is inferred between the highest station in fog (no sun, saturated air) and the lowest above it (sun by day / dry air by night); forecast from stratus/fog symbols, low clouds and sunshine of the same stations.
